description: This PHP source file defines the 'Cron' controller class within the Opencart admin marketplace module. The class manages cron job listings, execution, enabling/disabling, and deletion functionalities, facilitating administrative control over scheduled tasks.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace cron jobs, providing functionalities like listing, running, enabling, disabling, and deleting cron entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main cron management page with breadcrumbs, navigation links, and the cron list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of crons by calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of cron jobs, prepares data for display including URLs and statuses, and renders the cron list view.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a specific cron job identified by cron_id, using a store instance to run the associated controller.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected cron jobs by updating their status.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected cron jobs by updating their status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected cron jobs from the system.
